about_the_game:
Touching a Female Swordsman is a sexually suggestive game.

A female swordsman belonging to the rebel army has been captured by the kingdom's army, and a man in a kingdom mask starts touching her in order to get information out of her.

The game is easy to clear so that you can immerse yourself in the touching, but you need to reduce the female swordsman's fighting spirit (Fight) to zero. By rubbing, you can accumulate points and fight the female swordsman. Fighting is done automatically with the press of a button, and the winner is decided completely at random.

Saving is automatic and there is no penalty for game over, so you can immerse yourself in the game without fear of failure.

All actions can be performed with a single mouse click.

Select a rub button and click it to rub or lick.

Earn points while rubbing to defeat the female swordsman, and use the points to win the battle.

As the game progresses, you will be able to take off your armor.

There is only one stage. The ending of the game can be reached by reducing the fighter's Fight to zero.

Sex in the ending is consensual.

The situation is to touch the trapped female swordsman, but we added a sense of tension by inserting a fight in which you only have to press a button.

The English version is a machine translation.

content_descriptors.notes:
The game in general contains nudity, sexual descriptions of women and sex.
Sexual violence: There are depictions of a captive woman removing her clothes and touching and licking her breasts without her consent, playing with her genitals, and putting tools in her genitals.
A naked and bound woman is almost raped by a naked man.
Violence: An enemy is killed by a sword.
Sex is consensual.
